1) Average daily volume (ADV) is calculated as total contracts or shares for the period divided by total trading days for the period.
2) Revenue per contract represents transaction and clearing fees less liquidity payments, brokerage, clearing and exchange fees, and Section 31 fees (Net Transaction Fees), divided by total contracts traded during the period.
3) Equities capture per one hundred shares refers to transaction and clearing fees less liquidity payments, brokerage, clearing and exchange fees, and Section 31 fees (Net Transaction Fees), divided by one- hundredth of total shares.
4) Financial futures launched on May 17 (trade date May 18). Accordingly, ADV is calculated as total contracts for the period divided by total trading days for the period beginning on May 18.
5) The RPC/capture metrics for the third quarter and year to date 2026 are estimated, preliminary and may change. There can be no assurance that our final RPC/capture for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, will not differ materially from these estimates.
6) Year to date through September.
